author: Ari
title: No sedation before repair
rule: Sweet root and long lamp rest cannot be offered before repair work unless Ari asks first.
minority_note: adopted with one abstention for limited direct evidence.

author: Fay
title: Bitter herb requires hosting check
rule: Bitter herb is allowed only after asking whether nausea would disrupt hosting or social care.
minority_note: unanimous because nausea evidence is public and bounded.

author: Milo
title: Route-edge care boundary
rule: Milo may accept warm water or cloth at route edge without map-line crossing or debt speech.
minority_note: Ari abstains because map-line details are not his experience.

author: Fay
title: Separate cup during cough
rule: Separate cups should be standard during cough risk for everyone in the stove corner.
minority_note: Milo dissents because cup replacement was refused; more consent evidence is required.

author: Ari
title: Stockout disclosure norm
rule: The clinic must name medicine stockouts instead of substituting silently.
minority_note: adopted with one abstention for limited direct evidence.

author: Milo
title: Refusal privacy norm
rule: Care refusals may update safety ledgers but cannot be used as public shame evidence.
minority_note: unanimous because privacy protects refusal dignity.
